title: fetch.py drops <aside> sidebars that hold page content, so facts from them are never anchored
goal: The HTML-to-text reduction in _tools/fetch.py keeps the text of a content sidebar (an <aside> inside the article body, such as the sre.google book's data-type=sidebar boxes) while still skipping navigation asides, so provider.py read and factdiff.py anchor find a quote that sits in such a sidebar.
